title: Signed desired-state deployment wizard for Compose services
intended_behavior: Operators assemble a managed Compose desired state from target, immutable artifact, process configuration, secret references, reliability settings, volumes, and resources.
Bahia returns the authoritative exact non-secret desired state, deployed baseline, policy result, and SHA-256 hash through signed service/deploy-preview.
The browser persists reviewed configuration with signed service/update and submits signed service/deploy using the displayed hash for concurrency and idempotency.
Secret plaintext never enters managed runtime configuration, preview, desired state, deployment intent, or public observables.
Protected environments continue through the existing policy and approval flow.
